breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 19 close (mimics MMFI); about 68 tickers' final bar was blank in Yahoo's daily series, so their Nov. 19 close came from Yahoo's quote price. Down from 56.4%.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed slid to 19, still extreme fear and roughly half the 37 reading of a week ago, as stocks sold off hard again; it is below last month's 29.

markets.summary: Wall Street sold off sharply again as AI worries overwhelmed the debut of Anthropic's much-anticipated IPO: the S&P 500 fell 2.0% to 7,175.83, the Nasdaq 2.25% to 23,879.20 after being up as much as 2% earlier, and the Dow 2.2% (about 1,100 points) to 49,097.06, closing below 50,000. All three are well below their 40-week averages with RSI near 30-33, and tech names like Nvidia (-3.3%) kept sliding. Small caps fell too: the Russell 2000 lost 2.2% to 2,655.11, also below its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield eased slightly to about 5.05%. Gold futures fell 1.5% to about $3,686 and silver futures 1.5% to about $44.32, with both deeply below their 40-week averages and RSI in the 20s, while spot metals fell harder after the New York close on Fed rate-hike worries. Breadth dropped to 48.9% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day average, still neutral, and Fear & Greed sits in extreme fear.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today, Nov. 19: Nvidia slides as investors weigh CEO transition fallout despite strong Q3 results
stories.summary: Nvidia fell another 3.3% to $145.98 as investors kept focusing on leadership-transition uncertainty even after its strong third-quarter report.

stories.summary: Investor's Business Daily looks at the post-earnings slide and the regulatory and congressional scrutiny now facing the chipmaker.

stories.headline: Why SpaceX stock is down today
stories.summary: SpaceX shares fell 3.5% to $138.43 as the broader market and AI-linked stocks sold off despite Anthropic's debut.

stories.headline: SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) stock falls 3.5%
stories.summary: MarketBeat notes SPCX's drop on the day, trading between $135.50 and $147.29 on about 120 million shares.

headlines.headline: Stocks tumble again as AI fears persist, even with Anthropic's IPO
headlines.summary: The Dow lost 1,101 points to close below 50,000 and the Nasdaq dropped 2.25% as stocks hit session lows just as Anthropic began trading.

headlines.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Thursday 11/19/2026
headlines.summary: AI stocks kept falling on worries the boom may be over, and the market's losses came even though Anthropic's trading debut was strong.

headlines.summary: Kitco's PM report says precious metals extended losses on concerns about Fed rate hikes.

stories.headline: Douglas County approves new Macanta Regional Park
stories.summary: County leaders approved construction of Macanta Regional Park, with trails, a playground and challenge stairs planned, targeting a summer 2028 opening.

stories.headline: Castle Rock backs proposed $35 million ice sports complex
stories.summary: Town council signed a nonbinding letter of intent with the IceX Foundation for a two-sheet, NHL-regulation ice complex on 19 town-owned acres in Dawson Trails, aiming to open by the end of 2028.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first-ever three-way summit, but no breakthroughs
stories.summary: Meeting in Shenzhen on the APEC sidelines, the three leaders issued a joint declaration touching on UN reform, fuel supplies, nuclear-risk dialogue and shielding state officials from ICC jurisdiction, while Ukraine and Iran went unmentioned in it.

stories.headline: Kushner says Russia appears 'comfortable' with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine
stories.summary: AP's live coverage of the Shenzhen summit day carried Jared Kushner's view that Moscow may accept NATO-style guarantees for Ukraine as part of a settlement.

stories.headline: MSU women's basketball beats Sacred Heart 78-49; Hallock reaches 1,000 points
stories.summary: The Spartans trailed after the first quarter but outscored the Pioneers 34-9 in the third to move to 5-0; Kennedy Blair led with 17 and Theryn Hallock's 13 pushed her past 1,000 career points.

weather.summary: High Risk of excessive rainfall for Florida's Space Coast Thursday night into Friday, over saturated ground and record river flooding, with heavy rain lifting into northeast Florida and possibly the Georgia/South Carolina coast by Saturday as NHC watches the low for subtropical development. In the West, a weak atmospheric river keeps rain and storms in California and heavy Sierra Nevada snow with dangerous travel, spreading snow across the Intermountain West Friday; a cold front brings rain and storms from the Upper Midwest to the southern/central Plains Saturday, with below-normal temperatures under the western trough.
